title: Cape Canaveral as cover for non-space projects
place_text: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida

tellings.quote: If you put project X on Cape Canaveral Air Force Station they can always say oh well it's just related to the space program.

plain: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, the military launch base on the Florida coast, makes a handy cover for secret work that has nothing to do with space, according to a NASA doctor named Greg Rogers. Rogers, who says he worked there in the 1990s, explains it this way: "If you put project X on Cape Canaveral Air Force Station they can always say oh well it's just related to the space program." If he is right, any odd hardware or activity at the base could be hidden behind the space program.
